summary: Bayview Acquisition Corp (a blank-check SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its June 2024 merger agreement with Oabay entities and others. The amendment extends the outside closing date from June 15, 2026 to December 19, 2026, providing additional time to complete the de-SPAC business combination. No financial terms, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The filing reflects ongoing SPAC merger process mechanics; the key watch item is whether the parties consummate the deal by the new deadline or seek further extension. Risk-arb investors should monitor shareholder approval and any redemption trends.
